requirements.text: Proficiency in building backend systems using Java (Spring Framework or similar)
Advanced understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and object-oriented programming principles
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, the confidence to dig into unfamiliar systems on your own, and the judgment to know when to ask for help.
Experience working in production environments and resolving real-time issues
Familiarity with relational or NoSQL databases and foundational data modeling concepts
Strong communicator and collaborative teammate who supports others, stays coachable, and is always looking to grow.
Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your development workflow

This is a great opportunity for software engineers with minimum 3 years of professional industry experience in fast-paced or high-growth environments where priorities shift with the season and engineers are trusted to make decisions quickly and own the outcome.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms (AWS preferred), and modern DevOps practices
Interest in scaling systems, distributed architectures, and performance optimization
Desire to grow through mentorship, peer collaboration, and hands-on experience
Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth, or startup-like environments where priorities evolve regularly and decisions are made quickly.
Experience with Datadog or other observability tools
